purpose: Add natural Vietnamese guest register to agent support training without copying user reviews verbatim.
method: Reviewed public Vietnamese hotel/resort reviews and travel-service pages for recurring lexical and discourse patterns.
Extracted register-level patterns only: short clauses, omitted subjects, mình/nhờ/cho xin, mixed hotel English terms, common abbreviations and a small amount of unaccented texting.
Created new original paraphrases and mapped each to an existing validated semantic frame so labels and slots remain inherited from the dataset ontology.
Marked all additions training_priority=support to avoid overwhelming the cleaner primary examples.
Checked exact normalized overlap against existing training plus primary evaluation suites; zero overlap.
observed_patterns: máy lạnh không lạnh / vẫn nóng / yếu
nhờ ... giúp / cho mình xin ... / bên mình ... được không
book, check-out, late checkout, room service, housekeeping, spa, taxi used naturally inside Vietnamese sentences
short mobile-style messages with omitted subjects and occasional ko/k, 6h, 15h
complaints often state symptom first, then a short request for help
